Package com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener

Class MethodCallListener

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener.AbstractListener
      • com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener.MethodCallListener
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SimulationListener
    public class MethodCallListener
extends AbstractListener
    Simulation listener that counts method calls by invoke kind and by target, optionally recording the call sequence.
